name: – Daniel Freund – § 120, after point vii – Am 39
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2024, Section III – Commission and executive agencies and the ninth, tenth and eleventh European Development Funds
part_text: (vii a) not to use the Conditionality Regulation as a tool of undue interference and pressure on Member States, nor to invoke the rule of law in a biased and political manner, which in fact leads to the erosion of that principle;
